title: SWF: DisplacementMapFilter (FilterID 8) not encoded
description: DisplacementMapFilter is absent from both FlashFilter union (packages/core/src/engine/filters.ts) and SWF encoder (packages/swf/src/filters.ts). All 7 other Flash 8 filters are implemented. Needs new model interface, FLA binary decoder case 8, and SWF encoder writing FilterID=8 header with mapBitmap/mapPoint/componentX/componentY/scaleX/scaleY/mode/color/clamp fields per SWF spec.
